objective: GATE 3E-B MPRO SIDE-EFFECT CONTRACT. Descubrir en READ ONLY la logica observable alrededor de Pago_CXP: generacion de Pc_ID, modulos SQL que escriben/consumen Pago_CXP, estados/formas de pago, uso condicional de tablas hijas, relaciones con polizas/contabilidad/bancos y mecanismos de cancelacion/reverso. No ejecutar procedimientos, no escribir, no implementar Payment Executor.

queries.name: e3b_runtime_identity
queries.sql: SELECT @@SERVERNAME AS server_name,DB_NAME() AS database_name,SUSER_SNAME() AS login_name,USER_NAME() AS database_user

queries.name: e3b_modules_pago_cxp
queries.sql: SELECT TOP 200 s.name AS schema_name,o.name AS object_name,o.type_desc,sm.definition FROM sys.sql_modules sm INNER JOIN sys.objects o ON o.object_id=sm.object_id INNER JOIN sys.schemas s ON s.schema_id=o.schema_id WHERE sm.definition LIKE N'%Pago_CXP%' ORDER BY o.type_desc,s.name,o.name

queries.name: e3b_modules_pc_id
queries.sql: SELECT TOP 200 s.name AS schema_name,o.name AS object_name,o.type_desc,sm.definition FROM sys.sql_modules sm INNER JOIN sys.objects o ON o.object_id=sm.object_id INNER JOIN sys.schemas s ON s.schema_id=o.schema_id WHERE sm.definition LIKE N'%Pc_ID%' AND (sm.definition LIKE N'%Pago_CXP%' OR sm.definition LIKE N'%Cuenta_X_Pagar%') ORDER BY o.type_desc,s.name,o.name

queries.name: e3b_related_triggers
queries.sql: SELECT OBJECT_SCHEMA_NAME(t.parent_id) AS parent_schema,OBJECT_NAME(t.parent_id) AS parent_object,t.name AS trigger_name,t.is_disabled,t.is_instead_of_trigger,sm.definition FROM sys.triggers t LEFT JOIN sys.sql_modules sm ON sm.object_id=t.object_id WHERE OBJECT_NAME(t.parent_id) IN (N'Pago_CXP',N'Cuenta_X_Pagar',N'Pago_Cxp_Comprobante',N'Pago_CXP_Impuesto') ORDER BY parent_object,t.name

queries.name: e3b_dependency_graph
queries.sql: SELECT TOP 300 OBJECT_SCHEMA_NAME(d.referencing_id) AS referencing_schema,OBJECT_NAME(d.referencing_id) AS referencing_object,o.type_desc,d.referenced_schema_name,d.referenced_entity_name FROM sys.sql_expression_dependencies d LEFT JOIN sys.objects o ON o.object_id=d.referencing_id WHERE d.referenced_entity_name IN (N'Pago_CXP',N'Cuenta_X_Pagar',N'Pago_Cxp_Comprobante',N'Pago_CXP_Impuesto') OR OBJECT_NAME(d.referencing_id) IN (N'Pago_CXP',N'Cuenta_X_Pagar',N'Pago_Cxp_Comprobante',N'Pago_CXP_Impuesto') ORDER BY referencing_schema,referencing_object,d.referenced_entity_name

queries.name: e3b_accounting_candidate_objects
queries.sql: SELECT TOP 200 s.name AS schema_name,o.name AS object_name,o.type_desc FROM sys.objects o INNER JOIN sys.schemas s ON s.schema_id=o.schema_id WHERE o.name LIKE N'%Poliza%' OR o.name LIKE N'%Contab%' OR o.name LIKE N'%Banco%' OR o.name LIKE N'%Movimiento%' OR o.name LIKE N'%Egreso%' ORDER BY o.type_desc,s.name,o.name

queries.name: e3b_accounting_module_links
queries.sql: SELECT TOP 100 s.name AS schema_name,o.name AS object_name,o.type_desc,sm.definition FROM sys.sql_modules sm INNER JOIN sys.objects o ON o.object_id=sm.object_id INNER JOIN sys.schemas s ON s.schema_id=o.schema_id WHERE sm.definition LIKE N'%Pago_CXP%' AND (sm.definition LIKE N'%Poliza%' OR sm.definition LIKE N'%Banco%' OR sm.definition LIKE N'%Contab%' OR sm.definition LIKE N'%Egreso%' OR sm.definition LIKE N'%Movimiento%') ORDER BY o.type_desc,s.name,o.name

queries.name: e3b_payment_shape_by_form_state
queries.sql: SELECT Fp_Cve_Forma_Pago,Es_Cve_Estado,COUNT_BIG(*) AS total FROM dbo.Pago_CXP GROUP BY Fp_Cve_Forma_Pago,Es_Cve_Estado ORDER BY Fp_Cve_Forma_Pago,Es_Cve_Estado

queries.name: e3b_child_comprobante_by_form
queries.sql: SELECT p.Fp_Cve_Forma_Pago,COUNT_BIG(*) AS pagos,COUNT_BIG(c.Cxp_Folio) AS comprobantes_relacionados FROM dbo.Pago_CXP p LEFT JOIN dbo.Pago_Cxp_Comprobante c ON c.Cxp_Folio=p.Cxp_Folio AND c.Pc_ID=p.Pc_ID GROUP BY p.Fp_Cve_Forma_Pago ORDER BY p.Fp_Cve_Forma_Pago

queries.name: e3b_child_impuesto_by_form
queries.sql: SELECT p.Fp_Cve_Forma_Pago,COUNT_BIG(*) AS pagos,COUNT_BIG(i.Cxp_Folio) AS impuestos_relacionados FROM dbo.Pago_CXP p LEFT JOIN dbo.Pago_CXP_Impuesto i ON i.Cxp_Folio=p.Cxp_Folio AND i.Pc_ID=p.Pc_ID GROUP BY p.Fp_Cve_Forma_Pago ORDER BY p.Fp_Cve_Forma_Pago

queries.name: e3b_cancel_reverse_modules
queries.sql: SELECT TOP 100 s.name AS schema_name,o.name AS object_name,o.type_desc,sm.definition FROM sys.sql_modules sm INNER JOIN sys.objects o ON o.object_id=sm.object_id INNER JOIN sys.schemas s ON s.schema_id=o.schema_id WHERE (sm.definition LIKE N'%Pago_CXP%' OR sm.definition LIKE N'%Cuenta_X_Pagar%') AND (sm.definition LIKE N'%Cancel%' OR sm.definition LIKE N'%Baja%' OR sm.definition LIKE N'%Revers%' OR sm.definition LIKE N'%Anul%') ORDER BY o.type_desc,s.name,o.name
